en.headline: Debt servicing caps and referee ban for money lenders take effect
en.dek: First-phase measures prohibit lenders from requiring loan referees and set debt-servicing ratio limits of 35 to 40 per cent for unsecured personal loans to low-income earners.
body: The Government's first-phase measures to enhance regulation of licensed money lenders took effect on Saturday, including a ban on requiring borrowers to provide loan referees and new debt-servicing ratio caps for unsecured personal loans to low-income earners.

Under the rules, the monthly repayment for unsecured personal loans cannot exceed 35 per cent of income for borrowers earning HK$6,000 or less a month, or 40 per cent for those earning between HK$6,001 and HK$12,000. The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said the caps would protect the public and encourage more responsible lending.

Money lenders are also prohibited from asking borrowers to name loan referees, a step intended to prevent harassment of friends, relatives or employers by debt collectors. The bureau said the measures form part of a multipronged approach to curb excessive borrowing, with second-phase requirements scheduled for June 2027 that will require lenders to submit credit data to the Credit Data Smart system.

zh.headline: 放債人規管措施首階段今日生效 設供款比率上限及禁止要求擔保人
zh.dek: 首階段措施禁止放債人要求借款人提供貸款擔保人，並為低收入人士無抵押私人貸款設定35%至40%的債務供款比率上限。
body: 政府加強規管持牌放債人的首階段措施今日（8月1日）生效，包括禁止放債人要求借款人提供貸款擔保人，以及為低收入人士的無抵押私人貸款引入債務供款比率上限。
根據新規定，月入6,000元或以下借款人的無抵押私人貸款每月還款額不得超過收入的35%；月入6,001元至12,000元者則不得超過40%。財經事務及庫務局表示，有關上限可保障公眾，並鼓勵放債人更負責任地批出貸款。
放債人亦不得要求借款人提供貸款擔保人，以免親友或僱主遭追債人滋擾。局方指措施屬多管齊下應對過度借貸問題的一部分，第二階段要求將於2027年6月推行，包括規定放債人向「信資通」提交借款人的信貸資料。
